title: The Ember of the Glass Steppe
author: Wren Winterbourne
blurb: Ansel Quintana, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
